explainer: Reusable blueprint used to create structured, project-agnostic prompts for the Tab 9 prompt library.
how_it_works: The blueprint forces every prompt to declare identity, purpose, project-agnostic variables, triggers, inputs, outputs, file effects, safety boundaries, validation requirements, user-facing help metadata, prompt body, examples, and change log.

files_created.purpose: New reusable prompt text created from this blueprint.
Metadata sidecar that describes the new prompt.

risks: A project-specific prompt may accidentally be stored as reusable.
A prompt may imply code or governance changes even though Tab 9 is text-only.
mitigations: Require project-specific details to be expressed through placeholders or clearly labeled examples.
Require safety boundaries that forbid source-code, runtime, and governance edits unless a separate implementation workflow is explicitly invoked.
safe_usage: Use this blueprint to create prompt-library text artifacts. Do not use it to patch code, run tools, or update active governance.
example_usage: Create a new project-agnostic prompt by replacing adaptation variables and filling each required section.

change_log.summary: Initial text-only Tab 9 prompt-template blueprint metadata.
